name: bounce-ball-community
description: Bounce Ball game and clear-gated community map server

scripts.sync:android: npm run build:android:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:android:aab: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:toss:dev: node scripts/validate-toss-release.mjs --development && vite build --mode toss-dev && ait build
scripts.build:toss: node scripts/validate-toss-release.mjs && vite build --mode toss && ait build
